summary: Nu Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an independent limited assurance report on its managerial profit & loss reconciliation for Q1 2026. This is a routine financial reporting and internal control disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a voluntary supplemental investor presentation under US reporting rules. No corporate event, transaction, or special situation is announced. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. As a routine current report, it falls outside special-situations classification.
